description: Trigger: config.rs ExternalPinServiceConfig endpoint field is documented 'Must use HTTPS' but the validate() function does not enforce this. An operator can configure endpoint = 'http://...' and the daemon will start, silently sending bearer tokens over plaintext HTTP to the remote pinning service. Bad behavior: API keys are transmitted unencrypted, enabling credential theft by any network observer on the path between the daemon and the pinning service.
title: config.rs does not validate external pinning service endpoint requires HTTPS
